digest.component_or_area: Git fetch coordination and ticket store synchronization
propositions: Concurrent git fetch operations against a shared git common directory are not coordinated, causing ref compare-and-swap failures when multiple processes try to update the same remote-tracking ref.
The sync.reconverge path runs a forced-refspec fetch outside the store write lock and has no cross-process coordination mechanism for ref updates.
The snapshot fetch path locks only on the snapshot store, not across the shared git common directory where remote-tracking refs reside.
Parallel execution of rebar operations produces consistent stale-reference comparison failures that disappear under serialized execution, confirming the race condition.
A fetch coordination lock keyed on the canonical git common directory identity (following symlinks and commondir pointers) with bounded CAS retry prevents concurrent ref-update races.
